verdict.rationale: Moss is a semantic-search runtime and retrieval layer. Its evidence covers indexing, hybrid search and agent integrations (MCP, LangChain, Vercel AI SDK), where external models consume retrieval results. Nothing shows the product itself generating AI insights or suggestions from a user's data. A platform like this could plausibly offer such a feature (for example in a console), so the axis applies, but the pack has no evidence of it.
